checklist_steps.title: Pick your campuses and majors
checklist_steps.summary: Choose which UC campuses to apply to and your major at each. The fee is per campus.

checklist_steps.title: Enter your courses and grades
checklist_steps.summary: Type in every college course and grade from your transcripts. UC uses what you enter.

checklist_steps.title: Write your personal insight answers
checklist_steps.summary: Transfer applicants answer a set number of short questions, including one required question. Check the current rules on UC's page.

checklist_steps.title: Add activities and awards
checklist_steps.summary: List work, family responsibilities, clubs, volunteering, and awards.

checklist_steps.title: Pay the fee or ask for a waiver
checklist_steps.summary: Each campus has an application fee. Fee waivers are available for students who qualify.

checklist_steps.title: Submit by Nov 30
checklist_steps.summary: Submit before 11:59 p.m. Pacific on November 30, 2026.
